_note: AI-drafted Call to Worship — pending Wilson's curation.

registers.label: Spare
lines: A voice cries out in the wilderness.
Prepare the way of the Lord.
From a cut-down stump, a green shoot rises.
The hope of God is not finished with us.
The wolf will lie down with the lamb.
And a little child will lead them.
Come, let us worship the God who makes peace.
Come, Lord Jesus. Amen.

registers.label: Immersive
lines: Look at the stump, cut to the ground, and look closer — one green shoot is pushing up through the dead wood.
Come, Lord Jesus, come.
Out in the wilderness a rough voice is calling: straighten the road, fill the valleys, make a way home.
Come, Lord Jesus, come.
Picture the day the prophet saw — wolf and lamb together, the child unafraid, no one hurt on all God's mountain.
Come, Lord Jesus, come.
Welcome one another, then, as Christ has welcomed you, and turn your faces toward the One still coming.
Come, Lord Jesus, come. Amen.

registers.label: Hybrid
lines: A green shoot breaks from the old dead stump.
Come, Lord Jesus, come.
A voice in the wilderness: prepare the way.
Come, Lord Jesus, come.
The wolf and the lamb will rest together.
Come, Lord Jesus, come.
Come, let us worship the God of peace.
Come, Lord Jesus, come. Amen.
